title: Chinese Pandan Fun Fritters
description: Crispy keto fritters infused with the unique flavor of pandan, served with a side of pungent aioli.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the pandan leaves, coconut flour, chow chow, fun gu, eggs, salt, and pungent garlic powder. Blend until a smooth batter forms.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the fritters are crispy and golden brown.
Serve warm with a side of pungent aioli, made by mixing pungent garlic powder with mayonnaise.
